notes.title: HUGE ANNOUNCEMENT (Sequel coming)
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

It's been a while since I posted one of these,

I just want to let you all know that the sequel game for Haste-Miner 2, called "Eternamine" is soon ready for a full release. This is a title that has been under active development ever since the release of Haste-Miner 2.

This game has an incredibly increased amount of content and the quality is [b]much better[/b], a few examples are:
[list]
[*] 3 Different types of mines, including ones that go essentially infinitely deep with better stuff the deeper you go
[*] PvE zones where you fight enemies to gain rewards
[*] A skill tree with tons of different upgrades
[*] A shop system 
[*] Crate system has actual opening animations and you can see the potential rewards of each crate.
[/list]
And much much more. So if you liked Haste-Miner 2, this game will be right up your alley. So make sure to put it on your wishlist in order to get notified when the game is released. (Planned release around March)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2175570/EternaMine/

notes.title: Update notes for Sep 15
notes.content:
[b]Balance/QOL[/b]
- The price of most planets has been reduced
- The "Ghost block" mega upgrade now adds xp properly to your equipped spirit
-  The generators have received a slight buff

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed an issue where the "Spiritual" mega upgrade would not work

[b]Quality[/b]
- "Squeezed" the planets more together to make it clear that you can scroll
